name: Four Seasons Hotel Beirut
insider_take: Where Mediterranean luxury meets Middle Eastern hospitality in the vibrant heart of Beirut's cultural renaissance.
whats_special: This stunning property sits along Beirut's famous Corniche waterfront, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the dramatic Lebanese mountains. The hotel's prime location places you steps from the newly revitalized Beirut Central District, where ancient Roman ruins blend seamlessly with cutting-edge architecture. The rooftop pool deck provides one of the city's most spectacular sunset viewing experiences.
pro_tip: Book a sea-facing room on floors 15+ for unobstructed Mediterranean views and request late checkout to enjoy the hotel's legendary Sunday brunch that attracts Beirut's social elite.
dont_miss: The nearby National Museum of Beirut houses world-class Phoenician artifacts, while the trendy Gemmayzeh neighborhood (10 minutes away) offers authentic Lebanese cuisine and vibrant nightlife. Take an evening stroll along the Corniche promenade to experience local life, and visit the historic Pigeon Rocks formation just 15 minutes south for Instagram-worthy sunset photos.
pros: Prime waterfront location with Mediterranean Sea views
Exceptional Four Seasons service and hospitality standards
Multiple dining venues with international cuisine
cons: Urban setting in busy city center
